detachedPrompts.title: Prevent Drag and Drop when clicking on input text areas
detachedPrompts.content:
Prevent Drag and Drop when clicking on input text areas of the extension.
The name of task and name of prompts input elements are still being dragged
Let's make a dedicated Drag element on the UIs elements that are draggable. the other elements should behave normally, like being able to select specific parts of a text area

prompts.title: Add option to "Keep Hisotry"
prompts.content:
Right next to the option: "Auto Next" we need to add the option "Keep History"
If selected, any tasks/prompts on the queue flagged as Done will be archived. 
If not keeping history, simply deleted.
